QuestInfo.name: An Old Grudge
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p412# at #m10003004# looks the same as always.
QuestInfo.1: #p412# at #m10003004# said there was a #bhidden passage#k on the first floor of Niora Hospital, and that she could sense an unusually powerful force coming from somewhere deep inside it, suggesting I go take a look. To think a passage had been hidden away in a place like that... There might be something dangerous down there, so I'd better be well prepared before investigating, and then head back to #p425#. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: Deep within the hidden passage on the first floor of Niora Hospital, I came face to face with a powerful evil spirit. The spirit, named #b#o700006##k, was consumed by such deep resentment that there was no reasoning with it, so I had no choice but to strike it down. Just what on earth happened in this place?

0.0: Wh-what...? A powerful evil spirit is threatening this city...? Oh, how can something so frightening be happening? An evil spirit... just hearing that makes me scared to be alone tonight, so would you mind staying with me, just for tonight...? Hic... hic......
0.1: Oh, come to think of it, actually, I've been sensing something unusual around here myself lately. I suppose after being a patient here for so long, even the tiniest changes don't slip past me. Would you like to know more...?

yes.0: This isn't something anyone else knows, but... there's actually a #bhidden passage#k on the first floor of this hospital. There's such an unpleasant smell coming from inside it that I've never once gone in, but it must lead somewhere, without a doubt.
yes.1: But just recently, I've started sensing something ominous coming from deep within that passage...! I thought there might be something down there, but if that's what you're looking for... please! Get rid of that terrifying evil spirit! Hic...

no.0: I see... I suppose there's no need to listen closely to someone like me...

1.0: You're back. What happened with that girl's ghost...? Hm...? You're saying that with #p412#'s help, you found and defeated a powerful evil spirit called #b#o700006##k in the marshland inside Niora Hospital...? I can't believe it...

npc.0: There's a #bhidden passage#k on the first floor of this hospital, and lately, something unsettling has been coming from deep inside it. I'm so scared... hic...
